style.description: Director question 3. A folder name under styles/.

style_note.description: Only for a custom request: what the user asked for and which shipped style was chosen as the base.

env_key.description: NAME of the environment variable that holds the key. Never the key.

palette_tier.description: focused = a palette of 3 to 5 colours, expanded = 8 to 12. Decided before the palette (personas/director.md section 4).

palette_size.description: Number of colour roles in the chosen palette. Written by pick-design.js. focused: 3 to 5, expanded: 8 to 12.

design.description: Written by scripts/pick-design.js. Ids from the style design-system.json; never a hex or a font name.

ratio.description: From the platform preset in library/platforms.json.

subject_mode.description: Copied from the style's design-system.json subject_mode. layered = Narrator (presenter) or Actor characters; ui-first = no human figures.

angle.description: The belief the hook flips. Unsourced claims carry [VERIFY: ...].

domains.description: Subject domains of the topic. Domain-locked widgets (library/widgets.json `domain`) are allowed only when their domain is listed.

runtime_tier.description: personas/director.md section 2: chosen from narrative complexity, not a fixed cap.

genre.description: The routing genre from references/director-cheatsheet.md section 6.

style_reason.description: Why the Director chose this style for this topic when the user named none.

title: brief
description: The four Director answers plus the locked design.
